mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_review ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM order_review WHERE username=#{username} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM order_review r INNER JOIN `${lineTable}` l ON l.order_id=r.order_id WHERE l.item_id=#{itemId}

SELECT r.id, r.order_id AS orderId, r.username, r.rating, r.body, r.reply, r.replied_at AS repliedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_review r INNER JOIN `${lineTable}` l ON l.order_id=r.order_id WHERE l.item_id=#{itemId} GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM order_review r INNER JOIN `${lineTable}` l ON l.order_id=r.order_id INNER JOIN `${itemTable}` i ON i.id=l.item_id AND i.owner_username=#{owner}
